About this Event

This winter, the Bay Area gets its biggest Bollywood Christmas celebration. High On Bolly takes over OPAL for a spectacular night of music, festive energy, craft cocktails, Go-Go performances, and cinematic holiday production against a glowing San Francisco skyline.

Leading the celebration is DJ Tejas—one of India’s most celebrated Bollywood DJs—bringing his winter USA tour to Mountain View with an explosive set of Bollywood anthems, global hits, and dance-floor favorites.
Experience it inside OPAL Nightclub, South Bay’s premier nightlife destination, known for its stunning interiors, elevated atmosphere, and unforgettable parties.Saturday, December 19 | 9 PM to Late
OPAL Nightclub, 251 Castro Street, Mountain View
21+ Only
